metadata.scenario: A long-time client calls furious about two issues: the caregiver has been arriving 30 minutes late for two weeks, and there's an unexpected supplies fee on the latest invoice. They're considering cancelling service entirely and want a manager to call them.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Michael Brown. I’m calling because I’m really frustrated with the service we’ve been receiving. I’m sorry to hear that, Michael. Could you please tell me what’s been going on? Well, the caregiver has been showing up 30 minutes late for the past two weeks. It's unacceptable! I completely understand your frustration. I apologize for the inconvenience. Can you provide me with the caregiver’s name? It’s Sarah. And on top of that, there’s an unexpected supplies fee on the latest invoice. I see. Let me check on that supplies fee for you. What specific amount are you seeing? It’s an extra $45. I didn’t agree to any supplies fee, and now I’m considering canceling our service entirely. I understand your concern, Michael. Your satisfaction is our priority. I will investigate both the late arrivals and the charges right away. I hope you can resolve this quickly. It’s been really stressful for my family. I genuinely apologize for the stress this has caused. I will escalate this issue to our Client Services Manager, Angela Martinez. I want someone to call me back soon. I need to know what’s going to happen. Absolutely, I will ensure Angela contacts you by the end of the day. Can I confirm your phone number? Yes, it’s +13165557923. Thank you, Michael. I’ll make sure she has all the details before reaching out. Also, I want to make sure we have a reliable caregiver moving forward if we decide to stay. That makes sense, Michael. I can also help with caregiver matching to ensure a better fit for your family. Yes, please. If we stick with it, I want someone who is punctual and reliable. I will note that request. In the meantime, I’ll check on the supplies fee and the caregiver’s schedule. Thank you. I appreciate you taking the time to address this. Thank you for your understanding, Michael. We value your feedback and will work to resolve this promptly. I’ll wait for Angela’s call. Goodbye for now. Goodbye, Michael, and take care.
